translation: Baleza abantwana babo, amadodana nabantwana besifazane, ⟨את⟩ oonabanye bangcwele ezinikelwa abantwana abafowethu—hhayi: bahlabela ⟨את⟩ amadodana abo nomabuyebo babo ezinkonzweni zeziShedim ezibizwa ngokuthi uShadayi akusoze—bahlabela ⟨את⟩ amadodana abo nododakazi babo kumashadim (amadimonaka).
